notes.title: Foxy's Adventure - update 1.0.7 (2024)
notes.content:
1. A significant number of bugs have been fixed
2. more health has been added to the game, from now the maximum amount of health is 5 heart
3. from now, when a player is hurt, he will bounce off the opponent
